title: Challenge 3 Quiz - AI Tools Everyone Should Know

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of AI tools?
options: To help people complete tasks more efficiently
To eliminate the need for computers

questions.question: Which category of AI tools is mainly used to create articles, emails and reports?
Which AI tool is particularly useful for generating images from text descriptions?
Which of the following is a benefit of AI productivity tools?
options: They eliminate the need for human review.
They help automate repetitive tasks and save time.
They guarantee every response is correct.

questions.question: Why is it important to verify AI-generated information?
options: Because AI can sometimes produce inaccurate or outdated information
Because AI refuses to answer questions
Because AI never explains its answers

questions.question: Which factor should you consider when choosing an AI tool?
options: Whether it matches the task you want to complete

questions.question: What should you avoid uploading to AI platforms unless you fully trust their security and privacy policies?
Which statement about AI tools is TRUE?
options: One AI tool is the best at every task.
Different AI tools have different strengths.
AI tools are only useful for programmers.
Every AI tool provides the same features.

questions.question: What is generally the best strategy for beginners?
options: Install as many AI tools as possible.
Master a few reliable AI tools before expanding your toolkit.

questions.question: Why is continuous learning important when using AI?
options: Because AI technology evolves rapidly with new tools and features
Because AI tools stop working after one year
Because AI can only be used by certified professionals
